provenance.note: the reviewed head decides a timestamp has no year by testing the parsed value's year and day-of-year, so a year-only layout that parses a literal year zero takes the missing-year branch and the date is rewritten to today; the base behaves identically (the PR rewrote the same value-keyed test rather than introducing it), so the PR neither introduces nor repairs this defect, and the later fix adds layoutHasYear and gates both branches on yearMissing
